Scents of morning light, dewy cassis and sheer musk create the ultimate self-care fragrance among scented lotions. eos 24 hour moisture body lotion with instantly moisturizing Shea Oil + lasting protection Shea Butter quickly absorbs for 24-hour hydration. Say hello to fast-absorption, lightweight, soft skin, and sustainable shea. Say goodbye to body skin care products with greasiness, heaviness, and sticky residue. features: 24-HOUR DEEP HYDRATION: This scented moisturizing lotion delivers long-lasting hydration to relieve dry skin, leaving your whole body feeling smooth, radiant, and deeply replenished.
SHEA BUTTER MOISTURE BARRIER: Powered by our nutrient-rich blend of 7 oils and butters, including wild-harvested shea butter and protective Vitamin E, to soften skin and lock in moisture.
FAST-ABSORBING NON-GREASY FORMULA: A lightweight daily body moisturizer that glides on smoothly and absorbs instantly into the skin without leaving a heavy, sticky, or greasy residue.
CLEAN FRESH & COZY SCENT: Wraps your skin in a comforting, laundry-fresh fragrance featuring sensory notes of light cotton, soft musk, and a warm touch of vanilla for a clean-girl aesthetic.
DERMATOLOGIST RECOMMENDED: Dermatologist-tested, hypoallergenic, and completely free of parabens, phthalates, and gluten. Cruelty-free and designed for your daily self-care routine.
